[{'type': 'text', 'text': 'This roadmap outlines the step-by-step execution plan for the **YouTube Front-End MVP**, moving from the current "Partially Completed" status to a production-ready launch.\n\n### Phase 1: Foundation & Decision Finalization (Week 1)\n*   **Resolve Open Items:** Conduct the 30-minute clarification call to finalize the Tech Stack (Vite/TS/Tailwind v3), Render Model (SPA vs SSR), and Deployment Target (Vercel/Netlify).\n*   **Project Initialization:** Scaffold the project using `pnpm` and the chosen bootstrap tool (e.g., Vite).\n*   **Environment Configuration:** Set up `.env` templates for `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` and other service tokens.\n*   **Code Quality Standards:** Configure ESLint, Prettier, and Husky for pre-commit linting to ensure code consistency.\n*   **CI/CD Pipeline:** Establish GitHub Actions for automated building, linting, and "Preview Deployments" for every pull request.\n\n### Phase 2: Design System & UI Scaffolding (Week 1–2)\n*   **Design Token Mapping:** Extract hex colors, typography, and spacing from Figma into `tailwind.config.js`.\n*   **Core Layout Implementation:** Build the responsive shell (Navbar, Sidebar, Main Content area) using CSS Grid/Flexbox.\n*   **Atomic Component Library:** Develop reusable UI components:\n    *   `Button`, `SkeletonLoader`, `Avatar`, `Badge`.\n    *   `VideoCard`: Including hover states and metadata layouts.\n*   **Theme Engine:** Implement the Light/Dark mode toggle logic using Tailwind\'s `dark` class and `localStorage` persistence.\n\n### Phase 3: Data Architecture & API Integration (Week 3)\n*   **Mock Data Layer:** Create JSON mocks for Channel Metadata and Video Lists to allow UI development to continue independent of API quota usage.\n*   **API Service Layer:** Build the YouTube Data API v3 integration using `axios` or `fetch` with specific focus on:\n    *   Channel details fetch (Banner, Title, Subscriber count).\n    *   Video list fetch (Search or PlaylistItems endpoint).\n*   **Pagination Logic:** Implement cursor-based pagination using `nextPageToken` to trigger "Load More" or infinite scroll.\n*   **Caching Strategy:** Integrate a data-fetching library (e.g., TanStack Query) to handle the 5-minute in-memory cache and stale-while-revalidate logic.\n\n### Phase 4: Performance & Asset Optimization (Week 4)\n*   **Image Optimization:** Implement "Blur-up" placeholders and `srcset` for thumbnails to ensure fast FCP and visual stability (CLS).\n*   **Bundle Analysis:** Use `rollup-plugin-visualizer` to identify and tree-shake large dependencies to meet the **<100KB gzipped** target.\n*   **Lazy Loading:** Implement route-level code splitting and component-level lazy loading for non-critical UI elements.\n*   **Service Worker:** Set up basic caching for static assets (icons/fonts) via Workbox or the chosen framework’s built-in PWA features.\n\n### Phase 5: Accessibility (a11y) & Compliance (Week 4)\n*   **Semantic HTML Audit:** Ensure all components use correct tags (`<main>`, `<nav>`, `<article>`, etc.).\n*   **Keyboard Navigation:** Verify focus management for the video grid and theme toggle.\n*   **ARIA Implementation:** Add labels for icon-only buttons and descriptive text for screen readers on video thumbnails.\n*   **Automated Audit:** Run `axe-core` tests in the CI pipeline to catch WCAG 2.1 AA violations.\n\n### Phase 6: Testing & Quality Assurance (Week 5)\n*   **Unit Testing:** Write Vitest/Jest tests for utility functions, date formatting, and data transformation logic.\n*   **Component Testing:** Test UI components under different states (Loading, Error, Empty).\n*   **E2E Testing:** Script core user flows (Landing → Search/Filter → Click Video) using Playwright or Cypress.\n*   **Load Testing:** Verify the "Stale-while-revalidate" behavior when the YouTube API quota is manually throttled.\n\n### Phase 7: Deployment & Monitoring (Week 6)\n*   **Staging Review:** Deploy the "Final Candidate" to a staging environment for stakeholder sign-off.\n*   **Analytics & Error Tracking:** \n    *   Inject Google Analytics (gtag.js) for interaction tracking.\n    *   Initialize Sentry for production error reporting and source-map uploading.\n*   **Production Cutover:** Configure production domain (DNS) and point to the chosen hosting provider.\n*   **Post-Launch Smoke Test:** Verify FCP and Lighthouse scores on real-world 3G devices to ensure success criteria are met.', 'extras': {'signature': ''}}]
